name: african-icon-library
description: Monorepo for the African Icon Library — SVG assets, metadata, React exports, Figma plugin and website.

scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @african-icon-library/metadata && npm run build -w @african-icon-library/icons && npm run build -w @african-icon-library/react && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run build -w @african-icon-library/metadata && npm run build -w @african-icon-library/icons && npm run build -w @african-icon-library/react && npm run build -w @african-icon-library/figma-plugin && npm run release:build && npm run build -w @african-icon-library/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run validate && npm run verify:generated && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
